_sweep: A centred radial EFFECT is the one ask this generator would not take. Five variants of the melee sweep came back a beaded wreath, a saw blade, a clock face, a directional cut and a closed sunburst: 'arranged around an empty middle, seen from directly above' is a decorative RING to it, whatever it is told not to draw. The sweep stays procedural, and `sweepRing` breaks its ring on purpose because a closed hoop reads as a shield. Do not spend another generation on it without a genuinely different framing.
